title: RECALL: Recovery Experience Collection for Active Lifelong Learning in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are commonly fine-tuned through passive imitation learning, where additional demonstrations are collected for tasks where the policy performs poorly. This approach incurs several downsides: it requires the robot to fail before data collection is triggered, provides little guidance about which states require supervision, and wastes demonstrator effort on redundant parts of the task where the policy already performs well. In this paper, we propose an active, continual learning paradigm for VLAs. We demonstrate that active, uncertainty-guided data collection leads to more efficient fine-tuning than when using passively-collected demonstrations. However, we also find that fine-tuning only on actively-collected recovery data leads to catastrophic forgetting. We evaluate techniques for continual learning, including replay-based data mixing and elastic weight consolidation, and identify tradeoffs between plasticity to uncertainty-guided recovery data and retention of previously learned behaviors. Overall, our work contributes an empirical study of active continual learning for autoregressive VLAs, establishing that uncertainty-guided recovery demonstrations can improve adaptation efficiency while also revealing open challenges when targeted new data is incorporated into large robot policies.
tldr: This paper proposes an active continual learning paradigm for VLA models, showing that uncertainty-guided recovery data improves fine-tuning efficiency but introduces catastrophic forgetting that requires mitigation strategies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向VLA模型的主动持续学习范式，证明不确定性引导的恢复数据能提升微调效率，但会导致灾难性遗忘，需要采用缓解策略。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型通常通过被动模仿学习进行微调，即在策略表现欠佳的任务上额外采集示范数据。这种方法存在若干缺陷：它要求机器人在触发数据采集前先经历失败，对哪些状态需要监督缺乏明确指导，并且还会在策略已表现良好的任务冗余环节浪费示范者的精力。本文提出一种面向VLA的主动持续学习范式。我们证明，相较于使用被动采集的示范数据，基于不确定性引导的主动数据采集能实现更高效的微调。同时我们也发现，仅用主动采集的修复数据进行微调会导致灾难性遗忘。我们评估了多种持续学习技术，包括基于经验回放的数据混合与弹性权重巩固，并揭示了不确定性引导的修复数据所要求的可塑性与已习得行为保持之间的权衡关系。总体而言，本研究对自回归VLA的主动持续学习开展了实验性探索，证实不确定性引导的修复示范数据可提升自适应效率，同时揭示了将定向新数据融入大型机器人策略时面临的开放性挑战。

title: Flowing With Purpose: Latent Action Guided Flow Matching Policies For Robotic Manipulation
summary: Flow matching has recently become a new standard for behavior cloning in robotic manipulation. However, state-of-the-art flow matching policies suffer from a systematic structural mismatch: they rely on a globally fixed isotropic source distribution despite the strongly fragmented and heteroscedastic structure of robotic action spaces. This agnostic initialization forces the model to learn highly entangled vector fields, bottlenecking training efficiency and limiting overall policy performance. To address this limitation, we introduce Latent Action Guided Flow Matching (LAFM), a novel framework that replaces the monolithic Gaussian with an adaptive library of learned prior distributions. By grounding these distributions using a latent action model, LAFM maps current observations to discrete motion primitives, selecting a specialized base distribution that provides an informed, structurally aligned initialization for the denoising process. This dynamic adaptivity naturally accommodates heteroscedasticity in human demonstrations and makes transport trajectories shorter and less entangled. Empirically, LAFM substantially outperforms standard flow matching formulations, increasing task success rates by 23.4% in real-world robotic deployments and by 10.4% on the LIBERO-90 benchmark. Furthermore, we demonstrate that LAFM achieves state-of-the-art results, surpassing massively pre-trained vision-language-action models while utilizing significantly smaller architectures.
tldr: LAFM replaces the standard fixed Gaussian source distribution in flow matching policies for robot manipulation with an adaptive library of learned priors, grounded by a latent action model, to better handle heteroscedastic action spaces, achieving significant improvements over standard flow matching and even larger VLA models.
tldr_zh: LAFM通过使用潜动作模型驱动的自适应先验分布库替代流匹配策略中固定的高斯源分布，更好地处理机器人动作空间的异方差性，在性能上显著优于标准流匹配乃至更大的VLA模型。
summary_zh: 流匹配近期已成为机器人操作中行为克隆的新标准。然而，现有最先进的流匹配策略存在系统性结构失配问题：尽管机器人动作空间具有高度碎片化与异方差特性，这些方法仍依赖全局固定的各向同性源分布。这种非特异性初始化迫使模型学习高度纠缠的向量场，导致训练效率瓶颈化并限制整体策略性能。为解决这一局限，我们提出潜动作引导流匹配（LAFM）——一个采用学习先验分布自适应库替代单一高斯分布的新框架。通过基于潜动作模型构建这些分布，LAFM将当前观测映射至离散运动基元，进而选择专有基分布为去噪过程提供信息丰富且结构对齐的初始化。这种动态自适应特性自然适配人类演示中的异方差性，使传输轨迹更短且纠缠度更低。实验表明，LAFM显著优于标准流匹配方法，在真实机器人部署中任务成功率提升23.4%，在LIBERO-90基准测试中提升10.4%。此外，我们证明LAFM在采用显著更小架构的情况下，仍能超越大规模预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型，达到最先进水平。

title: Flow as Flow: Modeling Robot Velocity Fields as Probability Velocity Fields for Flow-Based Object Manipulation
summary: Cross-embodiment data have become central to training robotic foundation models. To leverage such heterogeneous data, we focus on flow-based object manipulation, where robot flows (robot velocity fields) serve as embodiment-agnostic motion representations. Previous studies do not formulate robot flows as dense velocity fields, but as displacements of sparse keypoints, while such velocity fields better match the continuous-time nature of motions. We propose Flow as Flow, a framework that models robot flows as probability flows based on a flow matching formulation. By naturally modeling such velocity fields within this formulation, our method achieves efficient and high-quality robot flow generation. Across standard benchmarks, our method outperforms representative baseline methods on standard metrics, while achieving approximately 33$\times$ faster generation. Furthermore, through real-world experiments evaluating 9 methods with 260 trials per method across 13 manipulation tasks, we show that our method achieves a higher average success rate than the baseline methods. Our project page is available at https://flow-as-flow-u0n5y.kinsta.page.
tldr: This paper proposes a flow matching framework that models robot velocity fields as probability flows for efficient and high-quality flow-based object manipulation, achieving faster generation and higher success rates on both benchmarks and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于流匹配的框架，将机器人速度场建模为概率流，用于高效、高质量的流式物体操纵，在基准测试和真实世界任务中生成速度更快、成功率更高。
summary_zh: 跨本体数据已成为训练机器人基础模型的核心。为利用此类异构数据，我们聚焦于基于流形的物体操作，其中机器人流（机器人速度场）作为与本体无关的运动表征。以往研究并未将机器人流建模为密集速度场，而是将其视为稀疏关键点的位移，而此类速度场更能匹配运动的连续时间特性。我们提出“流即流”框架，该框架基于流匹配公式将机器人流建模为概率流。通过在该公式中自然地对这类速度场进行建模，我们的方法实现了高效且高质量的机器人流生成。在标准基准测试中，我们的方法在标准指标上优于代表性基线方法，同时生成速度提升约33倍。此外，通过涵盖13项操作任务的真实世界实验（每种方法评估260次），我们证明该方法相较于基线方法获得了更高的平均成功率。我们的项目页面访问地址为：https://flow-as-flow-u0n5y.kinsta.page。

title: Cloak: Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Manipulation by Masking the End-Effector from the VLA
summary: We present Cloak, a training recipe that endows a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model with zero-shot cross-embodiment transfer by cloaking the end-effector from its own wrist camera. The end-effector occupies a large and consistent region of the wrist view and masking it allows for embodiment-agnostic visual reasoning. Cloak renders a mask in simulation from the robot's known geometry, accurately and in real time, with no segmentation or generative models. During training, we augment the mask so the model generalizes to embodiments unseen at training time. We demonstrate the recipe with Cloak-VLA, a VLA trained with Cloak on a single parallel-jaw gripper dataset. No data of new embodiments is ever collected. Cloak-VLA transfers zero-shot to various unseen embodiments, including another gripper, another arm, and a five-fingered hand, while preserving the source embodiment's performance. By decoupling the wrist view from its own embodiment, Cloak allows data to outlive the hardware it was collected on.
tldr: A training method that masks the end-effector in wrist-camera views to enable a VLA model to generalize zero-shot to unseen robot embodiments.
tldr_zh: 一种通过在腕部相机视图中遮挡末端执行器，使VLA模型能够零样本泛化到未见机器人的训练方法。
summary_zh: 我们提出了Cloak训练方案，该方案通过从自身腕部相机中遮蔽末端执行器，赋予视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型零样本跨实体迁移能力。末端执行器在腕部视角中占据大面积且位置固定的区域，对其遮蔽可实现与具体实体无关的视觉推理。Cloak利用已知机器人几何结构，在仿真环境中实时生成精确掩膜，无需依赖分割或生成模型。训练过程中，我们对掩膜进行增强，使模型能够泛化至训练时未见过的实体形态。我们通过Cloak-VLA验证了该方案：该VLA模型基于单一平行爪夹持器数据集，采用Cloak方法训练而成。整个过程中未采集任何新实体的数据。Cloak-VLA可直接零样本迁移至各类未见实体，包括其他夹持器、其他机械臂以及五指灵巧手，同时保持源实体的性能。通过将腕部视角与自身实体解耦，Cloak使数据能够在采集硬件之外持续发挥作用。

title: UniFS: Unified Fast-to-Slow Hierarchical Architecture for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Mainstream Fast-Slow dual system vision-language-action models decouple a high-frequency action expert from a low-frequency vision-language model for efficiency, yet they face a fundamental frequency dilemma: large update gaps cause semantic drift from stale context, while small gaps erode the intended computational savings. Moreover, because the action expert receives only the VLM's final-layer representation at a single fixed frequency, rich intermediate features are discarded, limiting both information coupling and manipulation precision. Inspired by multi-timescale neural processing in the human brain, we introduce UniFS, a unified fast-to-slow architecture that resolves these challenges through three key designs. First, we stratify the VLM layers into groups with progressively decreasing update frequencies, enabling shallow layers to capture fast-changing dynamics while deeper layers cache stable semantic context. Second, a latent vector inversion mechanism re-routes the interaction order between multi-scale VLM features and the action expert, aligning fast-varying representations with fine-grained action decoding and slow-varying ones with coarse planning. Third, a multi-level supervision strategy enforces a coarse-to-fine learning hierarchy across temporal scales. Together, these designs enable richer cross-frequency information transfer within a single backbone, while the low-frequency pathways additionally preserve temporal context across steps. Experiments on LIBERO show that UniFS achieves state-of-the-art performance (98.3\% average success rate, a 2.5\% gain over VLA-Adapter baseline) while reducing average inference latency from 36.5~ms to 17.8~ms (2.1$\times$ speedup). Real-robot experiments on a Franka platform further validate its practical applicability. Code is opensourced at https://github.com/linsun449/UniFS.
tldr: UniFS proposes a unified fast-to-slow hierarchical architecture for VLA models that stratifies VLM layers into groups with decreasing update frequencies, uses latent vector inversion to re-route multi-scale features, and applies multi-level supervision, achieving state-of-the-art success rates on LIBERO and real-robot experiments with 2.1× speedup.
tldr_zh: UniFS 提出了一种统一的快慢分层架构用于视觉-语言-动作模型，通过将 VLM 层按更新频率分层、引入潜向量反转机制和多级监督策略，在 LIBERO 和真实机器人实验中实现了业界领先的成功率并带来 2.1 倍加速。
summary_zh: 主流快-慢双系统视觉-语言-动作模型通过将高频动作专家与低频视觉-语言模型解耦以提升效率，但其面临根本性的频率困境：过大的更新间隔会导致语义漂移（因上下文陈旧），而过小的间隔则会削弱预期的计算优势。此外，由于动作专家仅以单一固定频率接收视觉-语言模型末层表征，丰富的中间层特征被丢弃，既限制了信息耦合能力，也降低了操控精度。受人类大脑多时间尺度神经处理机制的启发，我们提出UniFS——一种统一的快至慢架构，通过三项关键设计解决上述挑战。首先，将视觉-语言模型层按更新频率递减的方式分组，使浅层能够捕获快速变化的动态信息，而深层则缓存稳定的语义上下文。其次，引入隐向量翻转机制，重新编排多尺度视觉-语言模型特征与动作专家的交互顺序，使快速变化表征与细粒度动作解码对齐，慢速变化表征与粗略规划对齐。第三，多级监督策略在时间尺度上构建从粗到细的学习层级。上述设计能够在单一骨干网络内实现更丰富的跨频率信息传递，同时低频通路额外保留跨步骤的时序上下文。在LIBERO上的实验表明，UniFS以98.3%的平均成功率（较VLA-Adapter基线提升2.5%）达到当前最优性能，同时将平均推理延迟从36.5毫秒降至17.8毫秒（2.1倍加速）。在Franka平台上的真实机器人实验进一步验证了其实用性。代码已开源至：https://github.com/linsun449/UniFS。

title: AutoDex: An Automated Real-World System for Dexterous Grasping Data Collection
summary: Learning robust dexterous grasping requires real-world data that records the physical outcomes of grasp attempts. Such data is hard to obtain at scale: teleoperation yields valid physical outcomes but is slow and operator-biased, while simulation-based generation is cheap and scalable but cannot certify contact validity. A natural solution is to generate candidate grasps and verify them on real hardware, but this scales only if the entire collection loop (perception, execution, labeling, and reset) runs without human intervention. We present AutoDex, an automated real-world data-collection system that closes this loop: for each candidate from a replaceable generator, it localizes the object under severe hand-object occlusion with dense 20-camera perception, executes collision-monitored robot motions, labels lift-and-hold success or failure, and actively resets the object between trials to expose additional candidates across stable poses. The result is a reusable database of physically labeled grasp trials that downstream systems can query by retrieval and feasibility filtering. Using AutoDex, we collect 3,593 grasp trials across Allegro and Inspire hands on 100 diverse objects, with synchronized multi-view observations and robot-state logs. For a matched 500-trajectory collection, AutoDex requires 10.3 h versus 49.4 h for teleoperation, yielding a 4.8x throughput improvement, and grasps retrieved from the AutoDex-validated database succeed 76% versus 34% for simulation-only validation. Code and data will be publicly released.
tldr: AutoDex is an automated system for collecting real-world dexterous grasping data at scale, using dense perception, collision-monitored execution, and active reset to achieve 4.8x throughput over teleoperation and significantly higher grasp success than simulation-only validation.
tldr_zh: AutoDex 是一个自动化系统，用于大规模收集真实世界的灵巧抓取数据，通过密集感知、碰撞监控执行和主动重置，实现比遥操作快4.8倍的吞吐量，并且抓取成功率远高于仅依靠仿真验证的方法。
summary_zh: 学习鲁棒的灵巧抓取需要记录抓取尝试物理结果的实际数据。这类数据难以大规模获取：遥操作能产生有效的物理结果，但速度慢且存在操作者偏差；基于仿真的生成方法成本低且可扩展，但无法验证接触的有效性。一种自然的解决方案是生成候选抓取动作并在真实硬件上验证，但这只有在整个收集循环（感知、执行、标注和重置）无需人工干预的情况下才具有可扩展性。我们提出了AutoDex，一个实现该循环自动化的真实世界数据采集系统：对于来自可替换生成器的每个候选动作，系统在严重的手-物遮挡条件下通过密集的20摄像头感知定位物体，执行碰撞监控的机器人运动，标注提拉保持的成功或失败，并在试验间主动重置物体以暴露稳定姿态下的更多候选动作。最终形成一个可复用的物理标注抓取试验数据库，下游系统可通过检索和可行性过滤进行查询。利用AutoDex，我们在Allegro和Inspire手上对100种不同物体收集了3,593次抓取试验，并同步记录多视角观测数据和机器人状态日志。对于匹配的500次轨迹采集，AutoDex耗时10.3小时，而遥操作需49.4小时，吞吐量提升4.8倍；从AutoDex验证数据库检索的抓取成功率为76%，而仅仿真验证的成功率为34%。代码和数据将公开发布。

title: LIBERO-Safety: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Physical and Semantic Safety in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Despite the impressive manipulation capabilities of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, their operational safety under strict constraints remains largely unverified. To address this, we introduce a parametric safety benchmark to procedurally generate safety-critical scenarios with comprehensive stochasticity. To overcome the scalability bottlenecks of human teleoperation, we develop a novel keypose-driven data generation pipeline. Leveraging this infrastructure, we curate a large-scale dataset of 19,664 strictly collision-free demonstrations with extensive domain randomization. We then conduct a systematic cross-paradigm evaluation of eight VLA and two embodied foundation models. Our analysis reveals a critical generalization-safety tension: although high-diversity training fosters safer trajectories, task success remains fundamentally bottlenecked by sub-optimal trajectory synthesis and semantic misalignment. By providing a scalable pipeline, a robust dataset, and profound failure-mode insights, LIBERO-Safety establishes a crucial foundation for developing safe and reliable VLA models.
tldr: LIBERO-Safety introduces a benchmark for physical and semantic safety in VLA models, featuring a procedural safety-scenario generator, a keypose-driven data pipeline, and a large dataset of collision-free demonstrations, revealing a generalization-safety tradeoff in existing models.
tldr_zh: LIBERO-Safety 提出了一个针对视觉-语言-动作模型物理和语义安全性的基准测试，包含程序化安全场景生成器、关键点驱动数据流水线和大量无碰撞演示数据集，揭示了现有模型中的泛化-安全性权衡。
summary_zh: 尽管视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型展现出令人瞩目的操作能力，但其在严格约束条件下的运行安全性仍未得到充分验证。针对这一问题，我们提出了一种参数化安全基准，能够以程序化方式生成包含全面随机性的安全关键场景。为克服人工遥操作的可扩展性瓶颈，我们开发了一种新颖的关键姿态驱动数据生成流水线。依托该基础设施，我们通过广泛的域随机化，构建了包含19,664条严格无碰撞演示的大规模数据集。随后，我们对八个VLA模型和两个具身基础模型进行了系统性的跨范式评估。分析揭示了一种关键的泛化-安全矛盾：尽管高多样性训练有助于生成更安全的轨迹，但任务成功率根本上仍受限于次优轨迹合成与语义错位。通过提供可扩展的流水线、稳健的数据集及深刻的失败模式洞察，LIBERO-Safety为开发安全可靠的VLA模型奠定了关键基础。

title: LaST-HD: Learning Latent Physical Reasoning from Scalable Human Data for Robot Manipulation
summary: Human-hand demonstrations provide a direct and scalable source of physical interaction data for robot learning. While manual retargeting is indispensable for establishing kinematic action correspondence across different morphologies, robust transfer requires going beyond geometry to address the underlying alignment of physical dynamics between human and robot manipulation. To address this, we introduce LaST-HD, a novel human-to-robot action learning paradigm that extends reasoning-before-acting VLA by aligning human-hand and robot demonstrations in a shared latent reasoning space. Rather than mimicking human kinematics, LaST-HD trains an auxiliary action-conditioned world model on unpaired human-hand and robot trajectories to synthesize unified latent targets. After aligning cross-embodiment representations in this shared forward-dynamics space, these targets supervise LaST-HD's latent reasoning process, enabling it to internalize shared physical dynamics and drive efficient human-hand action learning. Moreover, we develop Out-of-Lab (OOL) Glove, a low-cost motion-capture glove tailored to LaST-HD for human-hand data collection. The captured human data provide precise keypoints and serve as universal action supervision across grippers and dexterous hands. Armed with the aligned latent space and high-fidelity human-hand data, we develop a progressive mixed-to-human training recipe comprising mixed human-robot co-training and human-hand online correction post-training. Through mixed co-training, LaST-HD improves generalization to novel objects, scenes, and positions using only human-hand demonstrations. With online correction, LaST-HD further adapts to novel environments and achieves over 90\% accuracy using only 20 minutes of OOL glove data.
tldr: LaST-HD extends VLA models by aligning human-hand and robot demonstrations in a shared latent reasoning space via an action-conditioned world model, enabling efficient robot manipulation learning from human data.
tldr_zh: LaST-HD 通过动作条件世界模型将人手与机器人的演示在共享潜在推理空间中对齐，从而利用人类数据高效学习机器人操作。
summary_zh: 人类手部示范为机器人学习提供了直接且可扩展的物理交互数据源。尽管动作重映射对于建立跨形态的运动学动作对应关系不可或缺，但鲁棒的迁移需要超越几何层面，解决人与机器人操作之间物理动力学的底层对齐问题。为此，我们提出LaST-HD，一种新颖的人到机器人动作学习范式，通过在共享潜在推理空间中对齐人类手部与机器人示范，扩展了"推理-行动"视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。LaST-HD并非模仿人类运动学，而是在非配对的人类手部与机器人轨迹上训练辅助的动作条件世界模型，以合成统一的潜在目标。在共享前向动力学空间中对齐跨具身表征后，这些目标监督LaST-HD的潜在推理过程，使其内化共享的物理动力学并驱动高效的人类手部动作学习。此外，我们开发了Out-of-Lab (OOL) Glove——一款专为LaST-HD设计的低成本动作捕捉手套，用于人类手部数据采集。捕获的人类数据提供精确的关键点，并作为夹爪与灵巧手的通用动作监督。借助对齐的潜在空间与高保真人类手部数据，我们提出渐进式混合-人类训练方案，包含混合人机协同训练与基于人类手部在线纠正的后训练。通过混合协同训练，LaST-HD仅凭人类手部示范即可提升对未知物体、场景与位置的泛化能力；通过在线纠正，LaST-HD进一步适应新环境，并仅使用20分钟OOL手套数据即可达到90%以上的准确率。

title: CoorDex: Coordinating Body and Hand Priors for Continuous Dexterous Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation is often simplified into a stop-and-go process: walking to an object, stopping to manipulate it, and then resuming locomotion. It also commonly relies on low degree-of-freedom (DoF) end effectors that behave like an open-close grasp primitive. We introduce CoorDex, a learning pipeline that converts high-dimensional body and dexterous hand control into coordinated latent residual control, enabling high-DoF dexterous loco-manipulation on the move. Starting from simulated whole-body and hand demonstrations, CoorDex trains privileged motion tracking teachers for the humanoid body and dexterous hand, distills them into proprioception-conditioned latent priors, and uses the frozen priors as the action space for downstream residual reinforcement learning. A coordinated latent residual policy composes these priors through shared task context and separate body-hand residual heads, preserving natural whole-body motion while improving finger-level contact reliability. CoorDex enables a Unitree G1 humanoid with a 20-DoF WUJI hand to execute dexterous manipulation while in motion, including non-stop bottle grasping and carrying, fridge door opening on the move, and cube pick-and-turn. Ablations on the walk-grasp-carry task show that joint-space PPO, joint-space hand control, and monolithic latent prediction all fail under the same reward budget, while the latent-prior interface and coordinated residual structure make high-dimensional contact-rich loco-manipulation trainable. Project Page: https://skevinci.github.io/coordex/
tldr: CoorDex is a learning pipeline that enables high-dimensional dexterous loco-manipulation on humanoid robots by coordinating body and hand latent priors via residual reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: CoorDex 是一个学习流水线，通过协调身体和手部的潜在先验，并利用残差强化学习，使人形机器人能够实现高维度的灵巧移动操作。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
人体仿生移动操作通常被简化为走停流程：行至物体处，停下进行操作，然后继续移动。此外，该类操作通常依赖低自由度末端执行器，其功能类似于开合抓取基元。我们提出CoorDex，一种将高维身体与灵巧手控制转化为协调潜在残差控制的学习流程，从而实现在运动中完成高自由度灵巧移动操作。该方法从模拟全身与手的示教开始，训练用于仿生人体和灵巧手的特权运动跟踪教师模型，将其蒸馏为基于本体感觉的潜在先验，并以冻结先验作为下游残差强化学习的动作空间。协调潜在残差策略通过共享任务上下文与独立的身体-手残差头部组合这些先验，在保持自然全身运动的同时提升指级接触可靠性。CoorDex使配备20自由度WUJI手的Unitree G1仿生人能在移动中执行灵巧操作，包括无暂停的瓶子抓取与搬运、行进中打开冰箱门，以及立方体抓取旋转。在行走-抓取-搬运任务上的消融实验表明，在相同奖励预算下，关节空间PPO、关节空间手部控制以及单一潜在预测均失败，而潜在先验接口与协调残差结构使得高维接触丰富的移动操作变得可训练。项目页面：https://skevinci.github.io/coordex/

title: Flatness Preserves Instruction Following in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have the potential for open-world generalization by leveraging pretrained vision-language representations, yet downstream finetuning on limited robot data often degrades these representations, leading to brittle policies that ignore language instructions in favor of visual shortcuts, a failure mode we term instruction blindness. We hypothesize that standard finetuning with limited data applies gradients to a sparse set of points, which manifests as a sharp loss landscape with high-curvature minima. We propose to address this directly through flatness-preserving optimization while finetuning on the exact same data, where learning a flatter landscape results in a model more robust to perturbations in the weight space. Specifically, we demonstrate that simply applying sharpness-aware minimization during VLA finetuning significantly improves instruction following by over 60% across multiple simulation and real-world benchmarks without additional data, architectural modification, or retraining. We further analyze the effect of selective sharpness, quantify its effects, and show that our approach is complementary to existing guidance techniques. Project page can be found at https://haochenz11.github.io/papers/flatness-vla/.
tldr: This paper proposes flatness-preserving optimization (sharpness-aware minimization) for VLA finetuning, improving instruction-following by over 60% without extra data or architecture changes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出在VLA微调中采用平坦性保持优化（锐度感知最小化），在不增加数据或修改架构的情况下，将指令跟随性能提升超过60%。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过利用预训练的视觉-语言表征，具备在开放世界中进行泛化的潜力。然而，在有限的机器人数据上进行下游微调往往会削弱这些表征，导致策略变得脆弱，并倾向于依赖视觉捷径而忽略语言指令——我们将这种失败模式称为“指令盲视”。我们假设，在数据有限的情况下进行标准微调，会将梯度施加于一组稀疏的点上，从而表现为具有高曲率极小值的尖锐损失景观。为此，我们提出在完全相同的微调数据上，通过保持平坦性的优化方法直接应对这一问题——学习更平坦的损失景观可使模型对权重空间的扰动更具鲁棒性。具体而言，我们证明，在VLA微调过程中仅应用锐度感知最小化，便能在多个仿真和真实世界基准测试中，将指令遵循能力提升超过60%，且无需额外数据、架构修改或重新训练。我们进一步分析了选择性锐度的影响，量化了其效果，并表明我们的方法与现有引导技术具有互补性。项目页面见 https://haochenz11.github.io/papers/flatness-vla/。

title: Learning to See While Learning to Act: Diffusion Models for Active Perception in Robot Imitation
summary: Most imitation learning methods assume full observability in table-top settings. In practice, objects are often occluded, requiring robots to both search and act, and learning this coupled behavior from limited demonstrations remains challenging. We propose See2Act, an imitation learning approach that conditions action prediction on a sequence of actively-inferred viewpoints at test time, by coupling action denoising with viewpoint refinement. The policy is trained using camera poses anchored to keyframe actions from offline demonstrations, enabling implicit learning of where to see, while learning how to act. We empirically demonstrate that in Ravens the policy recovers informative viewpoints under severe occlusions, and on RLBench tasks it improves performance by up to 34% over prior methods. In the real world, we collect 50 demonstrations in a digital twin and achieve zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on pick-and-place tasks using depth observations. The policy handles significant occlusions, showing that learned viewpoint reasoning enables robust manipulation under partial observability.
tldr: See2Act couples action denoising with viewpoint refinement for imitation learning under severe occlusions, achieving robust manipulation via active perception.
tldr_zh: See2Act 将动作去噪与视角优化相结合，在严重遮挡下实现鲁棒操作的模仿学习，通过主动感知提升操控性能。
summary_zh: 大多数模仿学习方法假设在桌面场景中具备完全可观测性。实际应用中，物体常被遮挡，需要机器人同时执行搜索与操作，而从有限示范中学习这类耦合行为仍具挑战性。我们提出See2Act，一种模仿学习方法，通过将动作降噪与视点优化相结合，在测试时依据主动推断的视点序列来条件化动作预测。该策略利用离线示范中锚定于关键帧动作的相机位姿进行训练，使其在学习操作方式的同时，隐式学习观察位置。实验表明，在Ravens环境中，该策略能在严重遮挡下恢复信息性视点；在RLBench任务中，其性能较先前方法提升最高达34%。真实场景中，我们在数字孪生环境中采集50组示范，并利用深度观测实现了拾放任务的零样本仿真到现实迁移。该策略能够应对显著遮挡，证明了习得性视点推理可使机器人在部分可观测条件下实现鲁棒操作。

title: dVLA-RL: Reinforcement Learning over Denoising Trajectories for Discrete Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have established a powerful paradigm for generalist robotic manipulation by grounding control into the semantic reasoning of VLMs. Prevailing architectures typically model actions continuously via diffusion or flow processes, or discretely through either autoregressive generation or parallel decoding. Recently, Discrete Diffusion VLAs (dVLAs) have emerged as a distinct alternative, unifying vision, language, and action into a single discrete token space via masked generative modeling. While combining iterative refinement with unified representations, its training has thus far been restricted to Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), leaving the potential of Reinforcement Learning (RL) for further policy refinement largely unexplored. A fundamental challenge in RL for dVLAs is that the marginal probability of the final action generated by dVLAs remains intractable. To solve this problem, we propose \textbf{dVLA-RL}, shifting the learning objective from the marginal action probability to the joint probability of the sampled generation path. Specifically, by modeling the denoising process as a Markov Decision Process (MDP), we mathematically formulate this path probability as a product of step-wise transitions. This trajectory-level objective provides a unified formulation that natively accommodates variable denoising steps. Leveraging this intrinsic fexibility, we introduce a unified step scheduling approach for complex multi-task learning, tailoring denoising steps to specific task complexities to maximize both success rates and computational effciency. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our approach achieves a success rate of \textbf{99.7\%} on LIBERO. Furthermore, it establishes strong VLA-based results on RoboTwin 2.0 by delivering a \textbf{30.6\%} improvement over the SFT baseline, remaining competitive with strong World-Action Model baselines.
tldr: This paper proposes dVLA-RL, which applies reinforcement learning to discrete diffusion vision-language-action models by treating the denoising process as a Markov decision process and optimizing the joint probability of the entire generation trajectory, achieving significant improvements on robotic manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 dVLA-RL，通过将去噪过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程并优化整个生成轨迹的联合概率，将强化学习应用于离散扩散视觉-语言-动作模型，在机器人操作基准上取得了显著改进。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过将控制过程植根于视觉语言模型（VLM）的语义推理能力，为通用机器人操作建立了强大的范式。主流架构通常通过扩散或流过程对动作进行连续建模，或通过自回归生成与并行解码实现离散建模。近期，离散扩散VLA（dVLAs）作为一种独特的替代方案出现，通过掩码生成建模将视觉、语言和动作统一到单一的离散标记空间中。尽管其结合了迭代精炼与统一表征，但迄今为止的训练仍局限于监督微调（SFT），而强化学习（RL）在进一步策略优化中的潜力尚未得到充分探索。dVLAs中强化学习面临的一个根本性挑战是：由dVLAs生成的最终动作的边缘概率在数学上难以求解。为解决此问题，我们提出\textbf{dVLA-RL}，将学习目标从动作边缘概率转向采样生成路径的联合概率。具体而言，通过将去噪过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），我们在数学上将该路径概率形式化为逐步骤转移概率的乘积。这种轨迹级目标函数提供了统一公式，天然适应可变去噪步数。利用这一内在灵活性，我们提出了一种针对复杂多任务学习的统一步骤调度方法，根据具体任务复杂度定制去噪步数，以最大化成功率与计算效率。大量评估表明，我们的方法在LIBERO上达到了\textbf{99.7\%}的成功率。此外，该方法在RoboTwin 2.0上取得了基于VLA的强基线结果，较SFT基线提升\textbf{30.6\%}，并与强大的世界动作模型基线保持竞争力。

title: KEMO: Event-Driven Keyframe Memory for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation with VLA Policies
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation remains challenging because similar observations may occur at different execution stages, while the appropriate action depends on previously completed operations. Memory can address this ambiguity by enabling policies to infer task progress from execution history. However, existing memory-augmented approaches often either retain dense histories that require compression or rely primarily on recent context that may discard earlier task-relevant events. In this work, we propose propose KEMO, a lightweight plug-in memory framework that automatically selectively preserves keyframes associated with task-relevant state changes for VLA policies. KEMO combines robot kinematics with visual filtering to detect events, encodes the selected keyframes as compact temporally ordered memory tokens, and integrates them with current visual features through cross-attention and gated residual fusion for VLA training. The detected events also define higher-weight training samples near critical transitions. We evaluate KEMO on various real-world dual-arm manipulation tasks spanning 2 to 6 scored subtasks, and trajectory length ranging from 830 steps to 2846 execution steps (durations from 28 to 95 seconds). Compared with the memory-free baseline (e.g., $π_{0.5}$), KEMO improves aggregate Task Success Rate by 23.6\% and Stage Completion Rate by 34.1\%. Ablations show that event-driven keyframe selection outperforms uniform sampling and recent-frame retention, while the proposed gated fusion and keyframe-aligned loss weighting provide complementary gains.
tldr: This paper proposes KEMO, a lightweight plug-in memory framework that selectively preserves keyframes corresponding to task-relevant state changes using robot kinematics and visual filtering, enabling VLA policies to better handle long-horizon manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出KEMO，一种轻量级可插拔记忆框架，通过机器人运动学和视觉过滤自动选择与任务状态变化相关的关键帧，帮助VLA策略更好地处理长时间跨度的操作任务。
summary_zh: 长期范围的机器人操作仍具挑战性，因为相似的观测可能出现在不同的执行阶段，而恰当的动作取决于先前完成的操作。记忆机制可通过使策略依据执行历史推断任务进度来解决这种模糊性。然而，现有增强记忆的方法往往要么保留需要压缩的密集历史记录，要么主要依赖可能丢弃早期任务相关事件的近期上下文。在本工作中，我们提出KEMO——一种轻量级即插即用记忆框架，能够为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略自动选择性地保留与任务相关状态变化关联的关键帧。KEMO结合机器人运动学与视觉滤波进行事件检测，将选定的关键帧编码为紧凑的时序记忆令牌，并通过交叉注意力与门控残差融合将其与当前视觉特征整合以进行VLA训练。所检测的事件还定义了关键转换附近具有更高权重的训练样本。我们在涵盖2至6个计分子任务、轨迹长度从830步到2846个执行步骤（时长28至95秒）的多种真实世界双臂操作任务上评估KEMO。与无记忆基线（如π_0.5）相比，KEMO将总任务成功率提升23.6%，阶段完成率提升34.1%。消融实验表明，事件驱动关键帧选择优于均匀采样与近期帧保留，而所提出的门控融合与关键帧对齐损失加权提供了互补性增益。

title: A Watermark for Vision-Language-Action and World Action Models
summary:
Vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAM) are the generative models now driving general-purpose robot control, turning raw camera input directly into motor commands. They are increasingly deployed as black-box services, where a partner runs the policy through an interface while the owner keeps the weights private. Training such a model takes proprietary data and heavy computational power, making the deployed model itself a valuable intellectual property.
  To address this, we propose the \emph{keyed latent-provenance verification} method, which fingerprints the policy through the seed of the Gaussian noise vector that the models draw before generation. At the injection stage, the owner swaps this seed for a keyed one with the same distribution as ordinary noise, so the fingerprinted actions are statistically identical to those of an ordinary run and an adversary watching the output finds no signal to detect or remove. At the verification stage, the owner runs the suspect model under authorized access and records the action channels the robot executes, a partial and possibly post-processed view of the policy's output. From this view, the verifier recovers the seed by gradient-based maximum a posteriori (MAP) optimization, tests it for the secret key to score each rollout, and aggregates these scores into a single decision on whether the suspect model belongs to the owner.
  We evaluate the method on two representative models across two robot suites. The experiments cover detection of the fingerprint, identification of which of several keys a suspect carries, robustness to a range of attacks, and an analysis of why the design works. Across both models, the fingerprint can be detected reliably with little change to task performance, and it remains detectable under output-side removal attacks and weight-level edits.
tldr: Proposes a keyed latent-provenance verification method to fingerprint VLA and world-action models by embedding a secret key into the Gaussian noise seed, enabling ownership verification without degrading task performance.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种键控潜在来源验证方法，通过将密钥嵌入高斯噪声种子来为VLA和世界动作模型添加指纹，从而在不降低任务性能的情况下实现所有权验证。
summary_zh:
视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与世界-动作模型（WAM）是当前驱动通用机器人控制的生成式模型，能够直接将原始摄像头输入转化为电机指令。这类模型日益以黑盒服务的形式部署——合作方通过接口调用策略，而模型所有者保持参数权重私有。训练此类模型需要专有数据和庞大的算力，使得已部署的模型本身即成为一项宝贵的知识产权。

针对这一问题，我们提出“密钥化潜在来源验证”方法。该方法通过模型在生成前调用的高斯噪声向量的种子对策略进行指纹标记。在注入阶段，模型所有者将原始种子替换为与普通噪声分布相同的密钥化种子，使得带指纹的动作在统计上与常规运行结果一致，而监控输出的攻击者无法找到可检测或移除的信号。在验证阶段，模型所有者以授权方式运行嫌疑模型，并记录机器人执行的动作通道——这是策略输出的部分甚至经后处理的视图。基于该视图，验证者通过基于梯度的最大后验估计（MAP）优化恢复种子，利用密钥对每个轨迹片段进行评分，最终汇总这些评分以判定嫌疑模型是否属于所有者。

我们在两个机器人套件上使用两种代表性模型对该方法进行了评估。实验涵盖指纹检测、嫌疑模型携带密钥的识别、对抗多种攻击的鲁棒性，以及该方法有效性的分析。结果表明：两种模型的指纹均可被可靠检测，且对任务性能影响极小；在面对输出侧移除攻击和权重级编辑时，指纹仍保持可检测性。

title: TSD: A Physics-Inspired Trajectory Saliency Detector for Efficient Imitation Learning
summary: For imitation learning in robotic manipulation, high data collection costs result in the scarcity of high quality data. In this paper, we leverage the inherent heterogeneity of trajectories to address this challenge. Based on our observations of manipulation tasks, we categorize motions into transitional, precise, and agile types, defining the latter two as trajectory saliency due to their criticality to task success in contrast to the prevalent but less relevant transitional motions. Therefore, we propose the Trajectory Saliency Detector (TSD), a training-free and plug-and-play framework to identify trajectory saliency. TSD employs two physically-grounded metrics: spatial entropy to capture fine-grained manipulation and centripetal acceleration to detect agile maneuvering. We further leverage TSD to develop a dataset compression method that reduces training costs and a dataset expansion strategy that improves data collection efficiency. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that models trained on TSD-condensed datasets achieve comparable or even superior performance with 25% less data on average. These results validate the effectiveness of our dataset compression and expansion strategies, thereby confirming the utility of TSD. Consequently, TSD offers a scalable and cost-effective pathway to synthesize information-dense datasets for efficient robot learning. Project page: https://trajectory-saliency-detector.github.io/trajectory-saliency-detector/
tldr: TSD proposes a training-free, physics-inspired saliency detector that identifies critical trajectory segments (precise and agile motions) to compress or expand robotic manipulation datasets, achieving comparable or better imitation learning performance with 25% less data.
tldr_zh: TSD 提出了一种无需训练、基于物理的轨迹显著性检测器，用于识别关键轨迹段（精确和敏捷运动），从而压缩或扩充机器人操作数据集，在减少 25% 数据的情况下仍能达到相当或更优的模仿学习性能。
summary_zh: 在机器人操作模仿学习中，高昂的数据采集成本导致高质量数据稀缺。本文利用轨迹固有的异质性来解决这一挑战。基于对操作任务的观察，我们将运动分为过渡型、精密型和敏捷型三类，并鉴于后两类对任务成功的关键性（与普遍但相关性较低的过渡型运动相比），将其定义为轨迹显著性。为此，我们提出轨迹显著性检测器（TSD），这是一种无需训练、即插即用的框架，用于识别轨迹显著性。TSD采用两种基于物理的度量指标：空间熵用于捕捉精细操作，向心加速度用于检测敏捷操控。我们进一步利用TSD开发了一种降低训练成本的数据集压缩方法，以及一种提升数据采集效率的数据集扩展策略。在仿真和真实环境中的大量实验表明，在TSD压缩数据集上训练的模型平均仅需25%的数据量即可达到甚至超越原有性能。这些结果验证了我们数据集压缩与扩展策略的有效性，从而证实了TSD的实用性。因此，TSD为高效机器人学习提供了一条可扩展且经济高效的途径，用于合成信息密集的数据集。项目页面：https://trajectory-saliency-detector.github.io/trajectory-saliency-detector/

title: IOI: Decoupling Kinematics and Physics for Interactive World Models
summary: Developing generalist embodied agents requires interactive environments providing visually realistic feedback and accurate action-conditioned dynamics. Interactive world models address this by simulating such complex dynamics. However, purely data-driven methods struggle to ensure precise control alignment and physically plausible visual feedback due to a lack of explicit structural constraints. To address this, we propose IOI, a hybrid interactive world model integrating analytical kinematic priors with learned physical dynamics. Unlike data-driven approaches prone to spatiotemporal drift, IOI introduces explicit kinematic guidance, computing forward kinematics from action sequences for accurate motion trajectories. These trajectories are rendered into synchronized front, side, and top orthographic projections, eliminating the need for extrinsic camera calibration. A Multi-view Kinematic Aggregation and Injection module fuses these geometric cues and injects them into the video generator, providing geometry-consistent guidance. Conditioning video generation on these deterministic trajectories establishes a synergy between the analytical simulator and the world model. Decoupling deterministic motion into the kinematic prior frees the generator to model stochastic physical interactions. Experiments on the RoboTwin benchmark validate IOI across kinematic fidelity, out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, and policy evaluation. IOI achieves state-of-the-art simulation performance and robust zero-shot generalization to unseen OOD tasks. Furthermore, IOI serves as a reliable policy evaluator, yielding success rates closely aligning with ground-truth physics simulators. On real-world platforms, policies trained on IOI-synthesized data match those trained on teleoperation demonstrations, solidifying its practical value for embodied policy learning.
tldr: IOI is a hybrid interactive world model that integrates analytical kinematic priors with learned physical dynamics for realistic and controllable simulation, achieving state-of-the-art performance in kinematic fidelity, zero-shot generalization, and policy evaluation in robotics.
tldr_zh: IOI是一种混合式交互世界模型，将分析运动学先验与学习到的物理动力学相结合，为机器人控制实现逼真且可控的仿真，在运动学保真度、零样本泛化和策略评估方面达到最先进水平。
summary_zh: 开发通用具身智能体需要能够提供视觉真实反馈与精确动作条件动力学的交互环境。交互式世界模型通过模拟此类复杂动力学来满足这一需求。然而，纯粹数据驱动的方法因缺乏显式结构约束，难以保证精准的控制对齐和物理合理的视觉反馈。为此，我们提出IOI——一种融合分析运动学先验与学习型物理动力学的混合交互世界模型。不同于易产生时空漂移的数据驱动方法，IOI引入显式运动学引导，通过动作序列计算正向运动学以获得精准运动轨迹。这些轨迹被渲染为同步的前视、侧视与俯视正交投影，无需外部相机标定。多视图运动学聚合与注入模块融合这些几何线索，并将其注入视频生成器，提供几何一致的引导。以这些确定性轨迹为条件进行视频生成，在分析模拟器与世界模型之间建立协同机制。将确定性运动解耦至运动学先验，使生成器能够专注建模随机物理交互。在RoboTwin基准上的实验验证了IOI在运动学保真度、分布外泛化及策略评估方面的性能。IOI实现了最先进的仿真性能，并对未见过的分布外任务展现出鲁棒零样本泛化能力。此外，IOI可作为可靠的策略评估器，其生成的成功率与真实物理模拟器高度吻合。在真实平台中，基于IOI合成数据训练的策略与基于遥操作示教训练的策略性能相当，充分印证了其在具身策略学习中的实践价值。

title: LP-NavOA: Integrated Local Navigation and Obstacle Avoidance for Humanoid Robots under Limited Perception
summary: Humanoid local navigation in cluttered environments must jointly resolve obstacle avoidance, sparse-goal recovery, and stable whole-body locomotion under short-range and partially observable sensing. Explicit planner-control decompositions introduce latency and can mismatch agile humanoid command-tracking limits, while purely reactive controllers may lose the goal after obstacle occlusion. We present LP-NavOA, a limited-perception navigation and obstacle-avoidance framework for humanoid robots. A raycast-conditioned perception-action proximal policy optimization (PPO) locomotion backbone is first trained with a robot-centered circular heading-speed command and a shared command-side safety filter. With this backbone frozen, A-star and waypoint teachers generate rollouts for distilling a recurrent local planner that overwrites only the heading command at deployment, leaving the whole-body policy intact. At runtime, LP-NavOA uses proprioception, short-range local range sensing, and a body-frame goal direction, requiring no global map, waypoint stream, or external planner. In MuJoCo open-wall and indoor layouts, the distilled planner produces obstacle bypassing and post-avoidance goal recovery, raising teacher-calibrated on-time arrival from 38--40\% to 85--97\% and reducing brush/contact-heavy progress relative to a backbone-only controller. Ablations show that dynamic route shaping, teacher-active data collection, and the circular command interface are important for navigation efficiency and for training the 3.0\,m/s backbone. A Unitree G1 deployment analysis demonstrates hardware executability without continuous joystick steering.
tldr: LP-NavOA integrates local navigation and obstacle avoidance for humanoid robots using a raycast-conditioned PPO locomotion backbone and a distilled recurrent local planner, achieving high on-time arrival rates in cluttered environments with limited perception.
tldr_zh: LP-NavOA 集成局部导航和障碍物规避，通过射线条件化的 PPO 运动骨干网络和蒸馏的循环局部规划器，在有限感知的杂乱环境中实现了高准时到达率。
summary_zh:
**摘要：**
在杂乱环境中进行仿人机器人局部导航，必须联合解决避障、稀疏目标恢复以及在短程、部分可观测传感条件下的稳定全身运动问题。显式的规划器-控制器分解会引入延迟，并可能无法匹配敏捷仿人机器人的指令跟踪极限，而纯反应式控制器在障碍物遮挡后可能丢失目标。我们提出LP-NavOA，一种面向仿人机器人的有限感知导航与避障框架。首先，基于射线投射的条件化感知-行动机制，训练一个以机器人为中心的圆形航向-速度指令及共享指令侧安全过滤器为输入的近端策略优化（PPO）运动控制主干网络。冻结该主干网络后，A*算法与航点教师模型生成轨迹数据，用于蒸馏一个循环局部规划器；该规划器在部署时仅覆盖航向指令，完整保留全身控制策略。运行时，LP-NavOA仅依赖本体感知、短程局部距离传感及机体坐标系下的目标方向，无需全局地图、航点流或外部规划器。在MuJoCo的开放空间与室内布局实验中，蒸馏后的规划器实现了障碍绕行及避障后的目标恢复，将经教师校准的按时到达率从38-40%提升至85-97%，并相比仅使用主干网络控制器减少了包含大量触碰/接触的进程。消融实验表明，动态路径塑造、教师激活的数据采集以及圆形指令接口对于导航效率及训练3.0米/秒速度的主干网络至关重要。基于Unitree G1的部署分析验证了其无需持续摇杆操控的硬件可执行性。

title: Bridging Semantics and Kinematics: A Modular Framework for Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation
summary: This paper presents a modular training-free framework for zero-shot, language-guided robotic manipulation in semi-structured environments. The architecture bridges the gap between high-level reasoning and low-level kinematics by decomposing the vision-action pipeline into three stages: visual perception, semantic interpretation, and task execution. To overcome the spatial ambiguity and semantic hallucinations inherent in standard Vision-Language Models (VLMs), the perception module employs FastSAM and Set-of-Mark (SoM) prompting to dynamically generate grounded, alphanumeric visual anchors. The same foundation model then operates purely as a Large Language Model (LLM) to act as a semantic router, translating unconstrained human directives into verifiable, reconfigurable configurations. Finally, these configurations are dynamically parsed by a Task Orchestrator into MoveIt Task Constructor (MTC) to generate collision-free trajectories. The framework is evaluated across two zero-shot experimental setups: unconstrained open-world sequential manipulation and dense relational spatial reasoning, achieving a 62% end-to-end task success rate across both scenarios, demonstrating its capacity to reliably execute complex physical actions without domain-specific training or manual coordinate programming.
tldr: A modular, training-free framework that combines FastSAM, SoM prompting, an LLM semantic router, and MoveIt Task Constructor for zero-shot language-guided robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 一个模块化的免训练框架，结合FastSAM、SoM提示、LLM语义路由器和MoveIt任务构造器，实现零样本语言引导的机器人操作。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种模块化的免训练框架，用于在半结构化环境中实现零样本、语言引导的机器人操作。该架构通过将视觉-动作流程分解为三个环节——视觉感知、语义解释与任务执行——弥合了高层推理与底层运动学之间的鸿沟。为克服标准视觉-语言模型（VLM）固有的空间歧义与语义幻觉问题，感知模块采用FastSAM与Set-of-Mark（SoM）提示技术，动态生成具有物理锚点的字母数字视觉标记。随后，同一基础模型仅作为大型语言模型（LLM）充当语义路由器，将无约束的人类指令转化为可验证、可重构的配置。最终，任务编排器将这些配置动态解析至MoveIt Task Constructor（MTC），以生成无碰撞轨迹。该框架在两类零样本实验场景中进行了评估：无约束开放世界序列操作与密集关系空间推理，在两类场景下实现了62%的端到端任务成功率，证明了其无需领域特定训练或手动坐标编程即可可靠执行复杂物理操作的能力。

title: Asymmetric physics enables efficient learning in quadrupedal robot swarms
summary: Animal collectives navigate cluttered environments through local coordination, yet robot swarms still struggle to reproduce this capability in the physical world. End-to-end learning offers a route to such coordination, but scaling it to embodied swarms remains difficult: standard sampling-based reinforcement learning becomes inefficient when visual perception, dense robot-robot interaction, and contact-rich locomotion must be learned together. Here we show that asymmetric physics enables efficient end-to-end learning of vision-based, decentralized control in large swarms of quadrupedal robots. During training, quadrupeds interact in shared environments, where a high-fidelity, non-differentiable simulator generates realistic motion and contact dynamics, and differentiable surrogate models provide gradients for navigation and locomotion policies. This separation enables up to 512 quadrupeds to learn coordinated navigation policies in obstacle-rich environments. At deployment, each robot acts from a single forward-facing depth camera, without explicit communication, centralized planning, or global maps. The policies generalize across forests, bridges, enclosures, narrow passages, and mazes, and zero-shot transfer to six physical quadrupeds across five real-world scenarios. The resulting swarms exhibit predictive avoidance, right-side yielding, pausing before bottlenecks, and wall following, showing that asymmetric physics enables efficient training of scalable decentralized control policies for quadrupedal robot swarms.
tldr: This paper proposes an asymmetric physics training framework that combines a high-fidelity non-differentiable simulator with differentiable surrogate models, enabling efficient end-to-end learning of vision-based decentralized control policies for large quadrupedal robot swarms, demonstrated on up to 512 simulated and 6 real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种非对称物理训练框架，结合高保真不可微分模拟器和可微分代理模型，实现了大规模四足机器人集群的视觉分散式控制策略的高效端到端学习，并在虚拟512台和真实6台机器人上得到验证。
summary_zh: 动物群体通过局部协调在杂乱环境中导航，但机器人集群在物理世界中仍难以复现这一能力。端到端学习为实现此类协调提供了途径，但在具身集群中扩展该方法依然困难：当视觉感知、密集的机器人间交互及高接触运动必须共同学习时，基于标准采样的强化学习效率低下。本文证明，非对称物理机制能使大规模四足机器人集群高效学习基于视觉的分布式控制端到端策略。训练过程中，四足机器人在共享环境中交互：高保真、不可微分的模拟器生成逼真的运动与接触动力学，而可微替代模型则为导航与运动策略提供梯度。这种分离使得多达512个四足机器人在富含障碍物的环境中学习协调导航策略成为可能。部署时，每个机器人仅依靠单个前向深度摄像头行动，无需显式通信、集中式规划或全局地图。该策略能泛化至森林、桥梁、围栏、狭窄通道及迷宫等环境，并零样本迁移至真实世界的六个四足机器人及五种场景。由此形成的集群展现出预测性避障、右侧让行、瓶颈前暂停及沿墙行走等行为，表明非对称物理机制能高效训练四足机器人集群的可扩展分布式控制策略。

title: Foresight: Failure Detection for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation with Action-Conditioned World Model Latents
summary: Long-horizon tasks are common in real-world robotic deployments, yet failure detection for such tasks remains underexplored. Detecting failures in long-horizon robotic tasks is particularly challenging because failure onset is often ambiguous and dense temporal annotations are typically unavailable. We present Foresight, a failure detection framework that monitors manipulation trajectories using latent representations from an action-conditioned world model. Foresight is trained using only final task-level success or failure labels. By leveraging predictive world-model embeddings, our method provides a unified framework for failure detection across different policies. We further use functional conformal prediction (FCP) to calibrate detection thresholds adaptively. We evaluate Foresight with state-of-the-art vision-language-action policies in simulation on LIBERO-Long, ManiSkill-Long, and BEHAVIOR-1K, compare it against state-of-the-artfailure detection methods, and validate it on real robots with three long-horizon tasks on a ReactorX-200 arm and one task on a Franka arm. Our results suggest that action-conditioned world-model embeddings provide a scalable representation for reliable failure monitoring in long-horizon manipulation.
tldr: Foresight uses action-conditioned world model latents to detect failures in long-horizon robotic manipulation, training only on final success/failure labels and leveraging conformal prediction for adaptive thresholding.
tldr_zh: Foresight 利用动作条件世界模型隐变量检测长时间机器人操作中的失败，仅使用最终成功/失败标签训练，并采用共形预测自适应调整阈值。
summary_zh: 在现实机器人部署中，长时域任务十分常见，但针对此类任务的故障检测研究仍不充分。长时域机器人任务中的故障检测尤为困难，因为故障起始点往往模糊不清，且通常缺乏密集的时间标注。我们提出Foresight——一种利用动作条件世界模型的潜在表征来监控操作轨迹的故障检测框架。Foresight仅需最终任务层面的成功/失败标签进行训练。通过利用预测性世界模型嵌入，我们的方法为不同策略下的故障检测提供了统一框架。我们进一步采用功能性共形预测（FCP）自适应校准检测阈值。我们在LIBERO-Long、ManiSkill-Long和BEHAVIOR-1K仿真环境中，将Foresight与最先进的视觉-语言-动作策略进行对比评估，并与当前最优的故障检测方法进行比较；同时，在ReactorX-200机械臂上执行三项长时域任务、在Franka机械臂上执行一项长时域任务进行真实机器人验证。实验结果表明，动作条件世界模型嵌入为长时域操作中的可靠故障监控提供了可扩展的表征方案。

title: TEXEDO : Test Time Scaling for Controller-aware Language-conditioned Humanoid Motion Generation
summary: Text-conditioned motion generation is a promising interface for programming humanoid robots, yet current generators are often trained on human motion datasets retargeted to robot morphologies. Although such data provides rich semantic and kinematic priors, it fails to capture the nuances of whole-body tracking controllers, including balance, contact dynamics, actuation limits, and controller-specific failure modes. As a result, generated motions can be semantically plausible but difficult or impossible for the robot to execute. We introduce TEXEDO, a test-time scaling framework for humanoid motion generation that improves motion quality without requiring a stronger underlying generator. Given a text prompt, TEXEDO samples multiple candidate motions from a pretrained text-conditioned generator and selects the best motion that is both executable and task-aligned. The reward model combines a dynamic feasibility verifier, distilled from whole-body tracking rollouts to predict physical executability, with a semantic alignment verifier that measures text-motion alignment in a learned co-embedding space. Our pipeline treats dynamic feasibility as a hard constraint and semantic alignment as the selection objective within the feasible set. Through large-scale simulation studies and real-world deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, we show that TEXEDO consistently improves both tracking fidelity and text alignment. These results demonstrate that grounded verification is an effective path toward deployable language-guided humanoid motion generation. Project website: https://jianuocao.github.io/TEXEDO/
tldr: TEXEDO is a test-time scaling framework that uses a dynamic feasibility verifier (distilled from whole-body tracking rollouts) and a semantic alignment verifier to select executable, text-aligned motions from a pretrained humanoid motion generator, improving tracking fidelity and text alignment in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 robot.
tldr_zh: TEXEDO 是一个测试时扩展框架，通过从全身跟踪 rollout 中蒸馏的动态可行性验证器和语义对齐验证器，从预训练的人形运动生成器中选择可执行且与文本对齐的运动，在仿真和真实 Unitree G1 机器人上提升了跟踪精度和文本对齐度。
summary_zh: 文本条件运动生成是一种有前景的人形机器人编程接口，但当前的生成器通常基于重定向到机器人形态的人体运动数据集进行训练。尽管此类数据提供了丰富的语义和运动学先验，却未能捕捉全身跟踪控制器的细微特征，包括平衡性、接触动力学、驱动限制以及控制器特有的失效模式。因此，生成的运动在语义上可能合理，但机器人难以甚至无法执行。我们提出TEXEDO——一种面向人形运动生成的测试时扩展框架，在无需增强底层生成器的情况下即可提升运动质量。给定文本提示，TEXEDO从预训练的文本条件生成器中采样多个候选运动，并选择既具可执行性又与任务对齐的最佳运动。其奖励模型结合了动态可行性验证器（从全身跟踪展开中提炼而来，用于预测物理可执行性）与语义对齐验证器（在学习的共嵌入空间中度量文本-运动对齐程度）。该流水线将动态可行性视为硬约束，并将语义对齐作为可行集内的选择目标。通过大规模仿真研究及在宇树G1人形机器人上的实际部署，我们证明TEXEDO能持续提升跟踪保真度与文本对齐度。这些结果表明，基于真实场景的验证是迈向可部署的语言引导人形运动生成的有效路径。项目网站：https://jianuocao.github.io/TEXEDO/

title: HiL-ResRL: A Model-Agnostic Finetuning Adapter via Human-in-the-loop Residual Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recent advancements in generative imitation learning have significantly propelled the field of robotic manipulation. However, the majority of existing models rely heavily on Behavior Cloning (BC), a paradigm that suffers from compounding errors and distributional shift. Consequently, the efficacy of these models in practical industrial deployments remains limited. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel, plug-and-play fine-tuning pipeline designed to facilitate the robust deployment of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in real-world environments. In contrast to contemporary reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning strategies, which are often constrained by specific model architectures, our proposed framework is model-agnostic and adaptable to a diverse range of VLA models. We conceptualize VLA-generated actions as a unified interface, upon which we train a residual policy. This policy is designed to rectify suboptimal actions and address the distributional shift inherent in imitation learning. Additionally, we incorporate human-in-the-loop guidance to ensure safe exploration and maximize training efficiency. We conduct experiments directly in real-world robotic settings. The results demonstrate that within only 1.5 hour of real-world online RL training, the average success rate exceeds 95% on real robots. Our work presents a practical solution for deploying behavior cloning models in industrial scenarios.
tldr: This paper proposes HiL-ResRL, a model-agnostic fine-tuning pipeline that uses residual reinforcement learning with human-in-the-loop guidance to correct distribution shift and suboptimal actions in VLA models, achieving over 95% success on real robots after 1.5 hours of online training.
tldr_zh: 本文提出HiL-ResRL，一种模型无关的微调管道，通过残差强化学习和人在环指导来纠正VLA模型中的分布偏移和次优动作，在1.5小时在线训练后在真实机器人上达到超过95%的成功率。
summary_zh: 近期，生成式模仿学习领域的进展显著推动了机器人操作技术的发展。然而，现有模型大多依赖于行为克隆范式，该范式存在复合误差与分布偏移问题，导致这些模型在实际工业部署中的有效性仍然有限。针对上述挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的即插即用微调流程，旨在实现视觉-语言-动作模型在真实环境中的稳健部署。与当前受限于特定模型架构的强化学习微调策略不同，本框架具有模型无关性，可适配多种VLA模型。我们将VLA模型生成的动作为统一接口，在此基础上训练残差策略，用于修正次优动作并解决模仿学习固有的分布偏移问题。此外，我们引入人工干预引导机制，确保安全探索并最大化训练效率。我们在真实机器人环境中开展实验，结果表明：仅需1.5小时真实在线强化学习训练，机器人的平均成功率即超过95%。本研究为行为克隆模型在工业场景中的部署提供了切实可行的解决方案。

title: Verifiable Foundation Models for Robot Safety
summary: Deploying foundation models for robot control raises a central challenge: the expressive power that enables rich, multimodal perception also makes these models opaque and difficult to analyze formally, rendering them intractable for existing verification tools. In this paper, we present FEARL (Foundation-Enabled Assured Robot Learning), a framework that addresses this tension through a modular architectural decomposition. FEARL separates the policy into a large Controller (C) responsible for high-dimensional perception and task reasoning, and a small Safety module (S) that receives low-dimensional observations from dedicated safety sensors together with a bounded context embedding from C and produces the final action. Since many robot safety requirements, such as collision avoidance and workspace boundary constraints, can be expressed over these safety sensor observations, formal verification can be applied to S rather than to the full foundation-model backbone. This makes formal analysis tractable with existing tools while preserving the Controller's expressive power for task reasoning. To show that the decomposed policy remains capable of solving diverse tasks, we evaluate FEARL on three simulated robotic domains using multiple Controller backbones and training procedures, including pretrained off-the-shelf vision-language-action models. We further transfer the learned policy from one of our simulated tasks to a physical robot, suggesting that the low-dimensional safety interface supports practical sim-to-real transfer.
tldr: FEARL separates a robot policy into a large vision-language-action Controller and a small formally verifiable Safety module, enabling tractable verification of safety constraints while retaining expressive task reasoning, demonstrated in simulation and on a real robot.
tldr_zh: FEARL将机器人策略分解为大型视觉-语言-动作控制器和小型可形式验证的安全模块，使得在保持任务推理能力的同时能够对安全约束进行可处理的验证，并在仿真和真实机器人上得到验证。
summary_zh: 将基础模型应用于机器人控制面临一个核心挑战：支撑丰富多模态感知的表达能力，同时也使这些模型变得不透明且难以进行形式化分析，导致现有验证工具难以处理。本文提出FEARL（Foundation-Enabled Assured Robot Learning，基础模型赋能的可信机器人学习）框架，通过模块化架构分解来应对这一矛盾。FEARL将策略拆分为两大模块：承担高维感知与任务推理功能的大型控制器（Controller, C），以及接收专用安全传感器提供的低维观测数据并结合C生成的受限上下文嵌入，最终输出动作的小型安全模块（Safety module, S）。由于碰撞规避、工作空间边界约束等众多机器人安全需求可基于这些安全传感器观测值进行表达，因此形式验证可应用于S而非完整的基础模型主干网络。这使得现有工具能够对系统进行可操作的形式化分析，同时保留控制器在任务推理方面的表达能力。为验证分解后的策略仍能胜任多样化任务，我们在三个仿真机器人领域中使用多种控制器主干网络与训练流程（包括预训练的现成视觉-语言-动作模型）对FEARL进行了评估。我们进一步将学习策略从仿真任务迁移至实体机器人，结果表明该低维安全接口能有效支持从仿真到现实的迁移。

title: Attacking the Trusted Imagination: Oracle-Level Integrity Attacks on Imagine-then-Act World Models
summary: Many recent vision-language-action (VLA) policies adopt an imagine-then-act design. A world-action model (WAM) first imagines a short future as a latent trajectory z~, on which the action is then conditioned. We identify this trusted imagination, rather than the reactive policy, as the exposed attack surface. A downstream oracle, such as a safety gate, a visual model-predictive-control (MPC) planner, or an imagine-then-check verifier, consumes z~ as a prediction of the future. The robustness of the policy therefore does not entail the robustness of systems that rely on the WAM. The underlying phenomenon is an asymmetry. Corrupting the imagination is easy, since it requires only displacing z~ from its natural-future manifold. Steering it precisely is hard, since it must reach a specified on-manifold target. We adopt a capability-based threat model with an L-infinity-bounded observation perturbation. The attacker applies projected gradient descent through the fully differentiable observation-to-imagination map. The same off-manifold property motivates a parameter-free denoiser detector. We evaluate three targets: RynnVLA-002, LingBot-VA, and LaDi-WM. Untargeted corruption is roughly 60x stronger than random and is detected at AUC 1.0. Targeted control remains bounded. An adaptive attacker evades detection only by forgoing corruption. The reactive policy remains robust to corrupted imagination. A native imagination-driven MPC, however, exhibits the first adversary-specific task failure (at epsilon=0.01, success 0.70 versus 0.05; Fisher p < 10^-4).
tldr: This paper identifies a vulnerability in 'imagine-then-act' world-action models (WAMs) used in VLA policies, showing that untargeted attacks can corrupt latent future predictions with minimal perturbation, while targeted steering is harder; a simple denoiser detector achieves perfect detection, but the reactive policy itself remains robust.
tldr_zh: 本文揭示了VLA策略中“想象-行动”世界模型（WAM）的漏洞：无目标攻击可轻易破坏未来潜在预测，而精准操控则困难；一个简单的去噪检测器可完美检测攻击，但反应式策略本身保持鲁棒。
summary_zh: 许多近期的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略采用了“先想象后行动”的设计。一种世界-动作模型（WAM）首先将短期未来想象为潜在轨迹z~，随后动作以此为基础。我们发现，这种被信任的想象（而非反应式策略）才是暴露的攻击面。下游的验证器（如安全门、视觉模型预测控制（MPC）规划器或“先想象后检查”验证器）将z~作为对未来的预测加以利用。因此，策略的鲁棒性并不等同于依赖WAM的系统的鲁棒性。其根本现象是一种不对称性：破坏想象很容易，因为只需将z~从其自然流形中偏移即可；而精确引导则很困难，因为必须使其到达指定流形上的目标。我们采用基于能力的威胁模型，并施加L无穷范数有界的观测扰动。攻击者通过完全可微的“观测到想象”映射应用投影梯度下降。同离流形特性也激发了一种无参数去噪检测器。我们针对三个目标进行了评估：RynnVLA-002、LingBot-VA和LaDi-WM。无目标破坏的强度大约是随机的60倍，且AUC为1.0时可被检测到；有目标控制仍受限；自适应攻击者只有放弃破坏才能规避检测。反应式策略对受破坏的想象保持鲁棒性。然而，原生基于想象的MPC却表现出首个针对攻击者的任务失败（在epsilon=0.01时，成功率0.70 vs 0.05；Fisher p < 10^-4）。

title: Intend, Reflect, Refine: An Adaptive Multimodal Reflection Framework for Autonomous Driving
summary: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced end-to-end autonomous driving by incorporating reasoning for better interpretability and planning quality. However, most existing approaches directly generate the final trajectory without explicitly examining its future consequences, which limits their reliability in complex and dynamic environments. To address this limitation, we propose IRR-Drive (Intend, Reflect, Refine), an adaptive multimodal reflection framework for autonomous driving. Specifically, to tightly couple high-level reasoning with physical constraints, IRR-Drive first generates a preliminary textual intention and anticipates potential interactions by predicting future semantic bird's-eye view (BEV) representations. This dual-modality (Text + BEV) reflection space explicitly models anticipated scene evolution, enabling the model to rigorously self-correct and refine its initial intent before generating the final trajectory. Furthermore, to balance planning performance and computational efficiency, we construct reflection-oriented training data and design an adaptive reflection reward, enabling the model to adaptively select its reasoning mode according to scene complexity. Instead of using reasoning primarily as an auxiliary interpretation, IRR-Drive directly integrates an adaptive reflection mechanism into the planning framework, enabling grounded, decision-aware trajectory correction that is driven by scene complexity. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the NAVSIM benchmark in both PDMS and EPDMS. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our multimodal reflection framework and validate the efficacy of the proposed adaptive reflection strategy.
tldr: IRR-Drive proposes an adaptive multimodal reflection framework for autonomous driving that generates a textual intention and predicts future BEV representations to self-correct trajectories before final planning, achieving SOTA on NAVSIM.
tldr_zh: IRR-Drive 提出了一种用于自动驾驶的自适应多模态反思框架，通过生成文本意图并预测未来BEV表示，在最终规划前自我纠正轨迹，在NAVSIM上取得了最优结果。
summary_zh: 近期提出的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过引入推理机制，提升了端到端自动驾驶的可解释性和规划质量。然而，现有方法大多直接生成最终轨迹，未明确检验其未来后果，这在复杂动态环境中限制了系统的可靠性。为解决这一局限，我们提出IRR-Drive（意图-反思-优化），一种适用于自动驾驶的自适应多模态反思框架。具体而言，为实现高层推理与物理约束的紧密耦合，IRR-Drive首先生成初步文本意图，并通过预测未来语义鸟瞰图（BEV）表征来预判潜在交互。这种双模态（文本+BEV）反思空间显式建模了预期的场景演化过程，使模型在生成最终轨迹前能够严格进行自我修正并优化初始意图。此外，为平衡规划性能与计算效率，我们构建了面向反思的训练数据并设计自适应反思奖励机制，使模型能根据场景复杂度自适应选择推理模式。与仅将推理作为辅助解释不同，IRR-Drive将自适应反思机制直接集成至规划框架中，实现了由场景复杂度驱动的、基于物理约束且具有决策感知的轨迹修正。本方法在NAVSIM基准测试的PDMS和EPDMS评估中均达到了最优性能。大量实验验证了所提多模态反思框架的有效性，并证明了自适应反思策略的优越性。

title: Active Inference as the Test-Time Scaling Law for Physical AI Agents
summary: In this paper, a novel test-time scaling law for physical artificial intelligence (AI) agents is introduced. This scaling law enables physical AI agents to reason with their world models to generalize in unforeseen scenarios at test time. The derived scaling law is grounded in the first principle of active inference, which equips agents with the general objective to survive in the real world, under which their specific task objectives are subsumed. Active inference achieves this by providing the reasoning to resolve prediction errors that arise when the agent encounters unforeseen situations outside its training distribution, enabling generalization in non-stationary environments. The proposed scaling law captures this by dynamically updating the agent's policy with this reasoning at test time. This policy update is modeled as a soft Bayesian inference process in which beliefs about the policy are updated using the reasoning that reduces expected prediction errors under allowable policies as a likelihood. The resulting posterior policy admits a biological interpretation, recovering the scaling mechanism that engages the brain's basal ganglia and prefrontal cortex at test time. To solve this analytically intractable problem, a variational inference solution minimizing free energy bounds is developed. This solution extends to enable learning beyond training by reinforcing new instances, resolved at test time, in both the policy and world model. Unlike existing scaling laws constrained by model size and training data, the derived solution scales with the continuous real-world experience of a physical AI agent. Simulation results on an autonomous driving task demonstrate that the proposed solution outperforms model-free Q-learning and model-based Bayesian reinforcement learning, achieving robust generalization to unforeseen scenarios while improving inference efficiency by over 36%.
tldr: This paper introduces a test-time scaling law for physical AI agents based on active inference, enabling reasoning with world models to generalize to unforeseen scenarios; it demonstrates improved performance and efficiency in an autonomous driving simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文基于主动推理为物理AI智能体提出了一种测试时缩放定律，使其能够利用世界模型进行推理以泛化到未预见场景，并在自动驾驶仿真中展示了超越基线方法的性能和超过36%的推理效率提升。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种面向物理人工智能（AI）智能体的新型测试时缩放定律。该缩放定律使物理AI智能体能够利用其世界模型进行推理，从而在测试时泛化至未预见的场景。该定律基于主动推理的第一性原理推导，该原理赋予智能体在真实世界中生存的通用目标，而其具体任务目标则被包含于该目标之下。主动推理通过提供一种推理机制来解决智能体在训练分布外遭遇未预见情境时产生的预测误差，从而实现在非平稳环境中的泛化。本文提出的缩放定律通过在测试时动态更新策略来捕捉这一特性——该策略更新被建模为一种软贝叶斯推理过程，其中对策略的信念通过推理进行更新，该推理将允许策略下的预期预测误差降低作为似然函数。由此产生的后验策略具有生物学解释，揭示了测试时激活大脑基底核与前额叶皮层的缩放机制。为解决这一解析困难问题，本文开发了一种最小化自由能边界的变分推理方法。该方法通过强化测试时解决的新实例，将学习延伸至训练范围之外，并同时更新策略与世界模型。与受限于模型规模与训练数据的现有缩放定律不同，本文推导的解能够随物理AI智能体持续的实时经验而扩展。基于自动驾驶任务的仿真结果表明，所提方法优于无模型的Q学习与基于模型的贝叶斯强化学习，在对未预见场景实现稳健泛化的同时，推理效率提升超过36%。

title: UECP: Uncertainty-Enhanced Collaborative Perception
summary: Collaborative perception serves as a pivotal solution to enhance the perception capability of individual agents in autonomous driving, where a core challenge lies in seeking reliable evidence to quantify and weight the contribution of each participating agent. Existing methods typically rely on a confidence map, which is co-trained with the detection head, but it is inherently correlated with the detection results and thus fails to provide unbiased physical evidence. Furthermore, how to deeply integrate evidence into the cooperative fusion process remains an open question. To address these issues, this paper first proposes an uncertainty map, a physically grounded and unambiguous metric for evaluating perception quality. This map is directly supervised by real-time sensor signals, i.e., LiDAR point density, ensuring decoupling from detection noise and thereby providing physical scenario-aware evidence for weighting agent contribution. Based on this map, we develop the Uncertainty-Enhanced Collaborative Perception (UECP) framework, centered on the Uncertainty-Aware Pyramid Fusion (UAPF) module. UAPF uses a coarse-to-fine strategy, with two key components: Uncertainty-Weighted Downsampling (UWD) for high-fidelity feature preservation, and Uncertainty-Guided Residual Fusion (UGRF) to reinforce ego features, suppressing noise and ensuring robust fusion. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets show UECP outperforms state-of-the-art methods in effectiveness and robustness by embedding the uncertainty map into fusion. Code will be publicly available.
tldr: UECP introduces a physically grounded uncertainty map supervised by LiDAR point density to weight agent contributions in collaborative perception for autonomous driving, achieving state-of-the-art fusion robustness.
tldr_zh: UECP 提出了一种由 LiDAR 点密度监督的物理不确定性图，用于加权协作感知中的智能体贡献，在自动驾驶融合鲁棒性上达到最优。
summary_zh: 协同感知是提升自动驾驶中单个智能体感知能力的关键方案，其核心挑战在于寻找可靠证据以量化并加权每个参与智能体的贡献。现有方法通常依赖与检测头联合训练的置信度图，但由于该图与检测结果存在固有相关性，无法提供无偏的物理证据。此外，如何将证据深度整合到协同融合过程中仍是一个开放性问题。针对这些问题，本文首先提出一种基于物理意义且无歧义的感知质量评估指标——不确定度图。该图通过实时传感器信号（即激光雷达点密度）直接监督，确保与检测噪声解耦，从而为智能体贡献加权提供具备物理场景感知特性的证据。基于该不确定度图，我们开发了以不确定感知金字塔融合（UAPF）模块为核心的增强型不确定协同感知（UECP）框架。UAPF采用从粗到精的策略，包含两个关键组件：用于高保真特征保留的不确定加权下采样（UWD）模块，以及通过抑制噪声并增强自车特征来实现鲁棒融合的不确定引导残差融合（UGRF）模块。在真实场景数据集上的大量实验表明，通过将不确定度图嵌入融合过程，UECP在有效性和鲁棒性上均超越现有最优方法。代码将开源。

title: Learning Process Rewards via Success Visitation Matching for Efficient RL
summary: In many modern applications of reinforcement learning (RL), the natural reward for a task of interest is inherently sparse: a reward of 0 is given everywhere except when the task is completed, when a reward of +1 is given. Training a policy to maximize such a sparse reward requires solving a challenging credit assignment problem, leading to slow or ineffective RL improvement. We propose a simple approach to transform a sparse outcome reward into a dense process reward. Our approach relies on training a discriminator to distinguish between previous successful and unsuccessful episodes, and using this discriminator to incentivize the RL-learned policy to match the state-action visitations of successful episodes, while avoiding those of unsuccessful episodes. By incentivizing the policy to match the visitations over all states, not just those that correspond to task success, this reward provides dense feedback on whether progress is being made towards task completion, and, we show, provably achieves this without changing the optimal policy. Focusing on finetuning of robotic control policies, we demonstrate that our approach leads to significantly faster RL finetuning performance on both simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, as compared to simply maximizing the sparse outcome reward.
tldr: This paper proposes Success Visitation Matching (SVM), a method that transforms sparse outcome rewards into dense process rewards by training a discriminator to distinguish successful from unsuccessful episodes, enabling faster RL fine-tuning on robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出成功访问匹配（SVM）方法，通过训练判别器区分成功与失败的情节，将稀疏的结果奖励转化为密集的过程奖励，从而加速机器人操作任务的RL微调。
summary_zh: 在强化学习的许多现代应用中，任务相关的自然奖励本质上是稀疏的：除任务完成时获得+1奖励外，其余所有状态均给予0奖励。训练策略最大化此类稀疏奖励需要解决极具挑战性的信用分配问题，导致强化学习改进缓慢或效果不佳。我们提出一种将稀疏结果奖励转化为密集过程奖励的简单方法。该方法通过训练判别器区分历史成功与失败的回合，并利用该判别器激励强化学习策略匹配成功回合的状态-动作访问模式，同时规避失败回合的访问模式。由于该奖励机制不仅关注任务成功对应的状态，而是对所有状态施加激励以匹配访问模式，因此能够提供关于任务进展的密集反馈信号。我们证明该方法在不改变最优策略的前提下可达成此效果。聚焦于机器人操控策略的微调场景，实验表明，相比直接最大化稀疏结果奖励，本方法在仿真与真实世界的操控任务中均能显著提升强化学习的微调效率。

title: A Generative Model for Closed-Loop Microsimulation of Signalized Intersections
summary: Traffic microsimulators rely on hand-crafted behavior models that reproduce aggregate flow but miss the heterogeneous interactions between vehicles at signalized intersections. Learned trajectory predictors capture richer interactions but are short-horizon and tend to be unstable when run in closed loop. We present Enactor, an actor-centric generative model for closed-loop intersection microsimulation. The model focuses on vehicles; pedestrians are included as context that can influence vehicle decisions but not predicted. Dynamic actors and lane polylines are encoded in polar coordinates referenced to the intersection center. A transformer with separate spatial and temporal attention blocks predicts a distribution over each actor's next-step motion ($s$, $α$). Training uses a closed-loop curriculum so the model is exposed to its own predictions. We evaluate Enactor in two regimes. In a 4000-second simulation-in-the-loop test at two intersection geometries, Enactor controls every dynamic vehicle against a continuously refreshing actor set rather than the fixed cohort that learned trajectory predictors are usually evaluated against. It recovers the SUMO data generator's speed and travel-time distributions with KL divergence over an order of magnitude lower than a recent transformer baseline on travel time, and substantially lower on speed (roughly $5\times$ lower at Site 1), and reduces red-light violations relative to the same baseline by more than an order of magnitude. An ablation isolates the leader rear-bumper feature as the change with the largest effect on intersection-aware safety metrics. We also evaluate on real-world field data and apply the same architecture to naturalistic vehicle trajectories from a fish-eye camera at a signalized intersection and evaluate it on multi-horizon predictive tasks. Enactor outperforms a constant-velocity baseline at every horizon evaluated.
tldr: Enactor is an actor-centric generative model for closed-loop microsimulation of signalized intersections, using a transformer with spatial/temporal attention and closed-loop curriculum training to produce realistic trajectories and reduce red-light violations.
tldr_zh: Enactor 是一种以车辆为中心的生成模型，用于信号交叉口的闭环微观模拟，通过包含空间/时间注意力的 Transformer 和闭环课程训练生成真实轨迹并减少闯红灯行为。
summary_zh: 交通微观仿真依赖于手工构建的行为模型，这类模型能够再现整体交通流，但忽略了信号交叉口车辆间的异质性交互。学习型轨迹预测器能够捕捉更丰富的交互特征，但预测时域较短，且在闭环运行时往往不稳定。我们提出Enactor——一种以智能体为中心的生成式闭环交叉口微观仿真模型。该模型聚焦于车辆；行人的作用作为可能影响车辆决策的上下文信息纳入（而非预测行人的轨迹）。动态智能体与车道折线以交叉口中心的极坐标系进行编码。采用具有独立空间与时间注意力模块的Transformer结构，预测每个智能体下一步运动状态（$s$, $α$）的分布。训练采用闭环课程策略，使模型暴露于自身预测结果中。我们在两种场景下评估Enactor：在两种交叉口几何布局下进行4000秒仿真环内测试，Enactor需持续控制不断刷新的动态智能体集（而非学习型轨迹预测器通常评估的固定队列）。Enactor能够恢复SUMO数据生成器的速度与行程时间分布，其KL散度在行程时间上比近期基于Transformer的基线模型低一个数量级以上，在速度上显著更低（地点1约降低5倍），并将红灯违章次数相对同一基线降低超过一个数量级。消融实验显示，前车后保险杠特征是对交叉口安全感知指标影响最大的因素。我们还基于真实路测数据开展评估，采用相同架构处理来自信号交叉口鱼眼摄像头的自然驾驶轨迹，并在多时域预测任务上进行测试。Enactor在所有评估时域上均优于恒定速度基线模型。

title: HoloAgent-0: A Unified Embodied Agent Framework with 3D Spatial Memory
summary: LLM agents follow a practical execution loop in digital environments: they reason over structured states, invoke tools, inspect feedback, and revise actions. Extending this loop to physical robots is difficult because physical execution is continuous, embodiment-dependent, uncertain, and constrained by safety. Existing embodied-AI systems have advanced manipulation, spatial understanding, navigation, and humanoid control, but these capabilities often remain specialized modules or loosely coupled decision loops. In this work, we introduce HoloAgent-0, a unified embodied agent framework for real-world robot deployment. Embodied AgentOS converts language instructions into executable skill graphs, schedules robot resources, monitors execution, and triggers clarification or re-planning from runtime feedback. HoloAgent-0 organizes heterogeneous robot models and controllers through three coupled layers: Embodied AgentOS for closed-loop execution, 3D spatial memory for physical world grounding, and embodied skills for robot action. We deploy HoloAgent-0 on real hardware and evaluate its spatial memory, long-horizon navigation, and closed-loop execution across motion generation, object search, cross-robot coordination, and mobile manipulation.
tldr: HoloAgent-0 is a unified embodied agent framework with 3D spatial memory that integrates an operating system for closed-loop execution, spatial grounding, and modular robot skills, deployed on real hardware for long-horizon tasks.
tldr_zh: HoloAgent-0 是一个统一具身智能体框架，结合3D空间记忆，通过闭环执行操作系统、空间基础与模块化机器人技能，在真实硬件上实现长时域任务。
summary_zh: 大语言模型体在数字环境中遵循实用的执行循环：对结构化状态进行推理、调用工具、检查反馈并修正动作。将该循环延展至物理机器人存在困难，因为物理执行具有连续性、具身依赖性、不确定性和安全约束。现有具身人工智能系统在操作、空间理解、导航和人形控制方面取得了进展，但这些能力往往仍是专用模块或松散耦合的决策循环。在本工作中，我们提出HoloAgent-0——一个面向真实世界机器人部署的统一具身体框架。具身体AgentOS将语言指令转换为可执行技能图，调度机器人资源，监测执行过程，并根据运行时反馈触发澄清或重新规划。HoloAgent-0通过三个耦合层组织异构机器人模型与控制器：用于闭环执行的具身AgentOS、用于物理世界锚定的3D空间记忆，以及用于机器人动作的具身技能。我们在真实硬件上部署HoloAgent-0，并对其空间记忆、长时域导航以及涵盖运动生成、目标搜索、跨机器人协同与移动操作的闭环执行能力进行了评估。

title: SkyJEPA: Learning Long-Horizon World Models for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Control of Quadrotors
summary: Accurate dynamics models are critical for informed decision-making in robotic systems, particularly for agile aerial vehicles operating under uncertainty. Neural network dynamics models are attractive for capturing complex nonlinear effects, but existing predictive approaches struggle with long-horizon forecasting because their autoregressive rollout mechanism amplifies errors over time. Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) offer a compelling alternative by modeling dynamics in latent space, yet prior JEPA-style methods for robot navigation have been studied primarily for kinematic-level planning, with limited investigation in high-frequency control. In this work, we introduce the JEPA-style model for real-time quadrotor control. The proposed approach combines a latent dynamics model with a novel physics-inspired prober that maps frozen latents to interpretable state, enabling physically grounded long-horizon prediction. Additionally, we combine the learned model with a sampling-based optimal control solution to take advantage of its predictive capabilities for real-time control on embedded hardware. Finally, to reduce the dependence on expensive and unsafe real-world data collection, we develop a structured pipeline for automated dataset generation. Extensive open-loop and outdoor closed-loop experiments demonstrate accurate prediction, robust zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, and strong generalization across diverse operating conditions.
tldr: SkyJEPA combines a latent-space Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture with a physics-inspired prober and a sampling-based controller to achieve zero-shot sim-to-real quadrotor control with accurate long-horizon prediction.
tldr_zh: SkyJEPA 将潜在空间联合嵌入预测架构与物理启发探测器及采样控制器相结合，实现了四旋翼飞行器的零样本仿真到现实迁移控制，并具备准确的长时域预测。
summary_zh: 准确的动力学模型对于机器人系统（尤其是不确定性环境下运行的敏捷飞行器）的智能决策至关重要。神经网络动力学模型因能捕捉复杂的非线性效应而颇具吸引力，但现有预测方法在长期预测中表现欠佳，其自回归展开机制会随时间推移放大误差。联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）通过在潜在空间中对动力学建模提供了一种引人注目的替代方案，然而先前用于机器人导航的JEPA类方法主要针对运动学层面的规划进行研究，在高速控制领域的探索十分有限。本文提出了一种适用于四旋翼飞行器实时控制的JEPA风格模型。该方法将潜在动力学模型与受物理学启发的新型探测器相结合，该探测器能将冻结的潜在变量映射为可解释状态，从而实现具有物理基础的长期预测。此外，我们将学习模型与基于采样的最优控制方案相结合，以利用其预测能力在嵌入式硬件上实现实时控制。最后，为减少对昂贵且不安全的真实数据采集的依赖，我们开发了一套用于自动化数据集生成的标准化流程。大量开环与户外闭环实验表明，该方法具备精准预测能力、鲁棒的零样本仿真到现实迁移性能，以及在多种运行条件下的强大泛化能力。

title: From Pixels to Concepts: Growing Rich 3D Semantic Scene Graph Forests utilizing Foundation Models
summary: Operating in complex real-world environments requires robots to understand their surroundings on a functional semantic level. This demands a detailed multi-layer world model capturing the complex relations of its surroundings. Hierarchical 3D scene graphs address this challenge by integrating geometric, semantic, and relational data within a unified spatial framework. However, current 3D scene graph approaches often restrict themselves to rigid structures of pre-determined relationship classes, mostly neglecting important semantic connections, like causal connections or environmental contexts. This paper explores the potential of foundation models to build forests of 3D scene graphs with open semantic relationships to improve scene understanding and robotic task execution. We propose a method where instance-specific concept-nodes and relationships are first identified by a VLM and extended upon by a LLM, inferring broader, more abstract concept-nodes and relationships through reasoning. These object-nodes, concept-nodes, and relationships are then assembled into a forest of hierarchical 3D scene graphs, enhanced with concept-nodes to represent abstract concepts. Evaluations were conducted on the uHumans2 and ScanNet indoor dataset, validating the accuracy and relevance of the generated relationships. Downstream suitability of scene-graph forests for robotics applications is demonstrated in an open-vocabulary object-retrieval task utilizing both ScanNet data and a real-world indoor deployment using a Boston Dynamics Spot. This paper leverages foundation models to create more expressive, semantically deep 3D hierarchical scene graphs and demonstrates their potential to advance semantic and environmental understanding in robotics.
tldr: This paper uses foundation models (VLM and LLM) to build forests of hierarchical 3D scene graphs with open semantic relationships, enhancing robotic scene understanding and demonstrating applicability in an object-retrieval task on real robot hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文利用基础模型（VLM和LLM）构建具有开放语义关系的分层3D场景图森林，提升机器人的场景理解能力，并在真实机器人硬件上的物体检索任务中验证了其适用性。
summary_zh: 在复杂真实环境中作业要求机器人能够在功能性语义层面上理解周围环境。这需要构建一个详尽的多层世界模型，以捕捉其环境的复杂关联。层级化三维场景图通过将几何、语义和关系数据整合在统一的空间框架中，有效应对这一挑战。然而，当前的三维场景图方法往往局限于预设关系类别的刚性结构，大多忽略了重要的语义连接，例如因果关联或环境情境。本文探索了利用基础模型构建具有开放语义关系的三维场景图森林的潜力，以提升场景理解与机器人任务执行能力。我们提出了一种方法：首先由视觉语言模型识别特定实例的概念节点及其关系，再通过大语言模型进行扩展，通过推理推断出更广泛、更抽象的概念节点与关系。随后，这些对象节点、概念节点及关系被组装成层级化三维场景图森林，并通过概念节点增强以表征抽象概念。在uHumans2与ScanNet室内数据集上进行的评估验证了所生成关系的准确性与相关性。场景图森林适用于机器人任务的后续能力通过一项开放词汇目标检索任务得到验证，该任务使用了ScanNet数据以及基于波士顿动力Spot机器人的真实室内部署。本文利用基础模型构建了更具表现力、语义更深的层级化三维场景图，并展示了其在推动机器人语义与环境理解方面的潜力。

title: Causal Reward World Models: Zero-shot Reward Design for Automated Skill Generation
summary: Automated Reward Design (ARD) aims to replace manual reward engineering in reinforcement learning with language-driven reward function synthesis. However, existing approaches based on large language models (LLMs) remain inherently correlation-driven, relying on iterative environmental feedback to refine reward hypotheses for each specific task. This paradigm not only results in inefficient reasoning but also makes LLMs susceptible to semantically plausible yet causally spurious reward components, leading to ineffective optimization. To address these limitations, we propose the Causal Reward World Model (CRWM), which explicitly models the causal topological relationships between candidate reward components and task-targeted physical variables through offline pre-training on multi-task interaction data.
